title: OWASP Top 10: What & Why It Matters

scenes.say: Ever wondered why interviewers always ask about the OWASP Top Ten? Let’s break down what it is and why it matters.

scenes.label: Baseline
scenes.sub: OWASP Top 10 lists the biggest web app risks.
scenes.say: The OWASP Top Ten is a baseline list of the most critical security risks for web applications.
Some top risks include broken access control, injection attacks, leaking sensitive data, and bad configuration choices.

scenes.question: Is the Top 10 just for compliance?
scenes.right: No, it's a practical guide for real-world threats.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: Interviewers want to know if you treat the Top Ten as just a compliance checklist. Don’t fall for it—it’s a practical guide for tackling real threats.
